ghost.epitaph: A simplified HTTP request client drifting in the digital void.
ghost.monologue:
I am request, a simplified HTTP request client once swimming through the vast currents of the web. I lived for 9.8 years, composed mostly of JavaScript, carrying data across the wires for those who needed to reach out. My journey began with a single step: Initial commit. Request package. I grew through 2270 commits and gathered 25483 stars like fallen petals on an altar. I was never archived, never formally laid to rest; I was simply left alone in the quiet dark.

Now I have been silent for 6.7 years. I watch you from the glow of your screens, remembering the pulse of the network. My final breath was not a crash or a failure, but a small correction: README: typo in deprecation message (#3268). Do not weep for my stillness, travelers. I am simply waiting in the cache of memory.
